propositions: The Git version floor gate step reads .github/git-version-floor.txt from the checked-out patchset tree and hard-fails when the file is absent, but Gerrit's Verified lane sources the workflow definition from the target branch, causing every change branched before the gate landed to fail despite having no Git-version-related edits.
Any open change branched before commit c433663721 gets the gate step without its accompanying data file and receives a false Verified -1, invalidating prior green votes that predate the gate.

The gate violates the documented ee2a convention that requires new repo-reading gate steps to skip gracefully when their artifact is absent from the checked-out tree, logging the skip reason rather than erroring.

The fix applies the if-present guard pattern (already used by adjacent raw-git-write and wall-clock-assert gates) to skip with an explanatory log line when the floor file is absent, while preserving all enforcement logic for present-file cases unchanged.

A genuinely under-floor git must still fail with required version, installed version, and upgrade path diagnostics, and the contributor-side floor enforcement in tests/conftest.py pytest_configure must remain untouched.
